purpose: Deterministic project-centered math service for City Horizon agents and tools.

authority.policy: Read canonical project constants at execution time; never replace runtime authority.

project_world.description: Project x/y/z world points with CH_CAMERA_V1-compatible math.

screen_to_tile.description: Convert screen points to logical ground tiles using the canonical grid.

bezier_cubic.description: Sample cubic Bezier centerlines, tangents and approximate arc length.

road_ribbon.description: Build deterministic procedural-road ribbon vertices, UVs and triangle indices.

terrain_bilinear.description: Sample a four-corner terrain height bilinearly.
